_설명: 심화 5과 수동태 — 보기 순서만 섞여 있던 객관식을 손으로 새로 썼다. 묻는 것과 푸는 방법은 그대로 두고 문장과 보기를 바꿨다.

문항.포인트: 수동태로 쓸 수 없는 동사와 자리
choices: He was cooked dinner by me.
Sora was bought a ring by Owen.
The Avengers were directed by Whedon.
Hansel and Gretel were afraid of the witch.
The first coin in Asia was appeared in China.
문항.explanation: cook·buy는 간접목적어를 주어로 한 수동태를 쓰지 않고, 작품 제목은 단수 취급하며, appear는 수동태로 쓸 수 없다.

문항.prompt: 능동태를 수동태로 고친 문장으로 바르지 [[않은]] 것은?
choices: They will send you a message. → A message will be sent to you by them.
Some people call him a genius. → He is called a genius by some people.
She will finish the report by noon. → The report will be finished by noon by her.
His dad didn't allow him to play games. → He didn't allowed to play games by his dad.
A young writer wrote the poem. → The poem was written by a young writer.
문항.explanation: 수동태의 부정은 was not allowed처럼 be동사 뒤에 not을 붙여야 한다.

body: You can use oil instead of butter.
choices: Oil can be used instead of butter.
Butter can be used instead of oil.
You can use butter instead of oil.
You can use both butter and oil.
You can use neither butter nor oil.
문항.explanation: 목적어 oil을 주어로 보내 「can be + 과거분사」로 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 밑줄 친 부분을 어법에 맞게 바꾸어 쓴 것은?
body: Salt [[used]] for keeping food fresh throughout
문항.explanation: 역사를 통틀어 지금까지 쓰여 왔으므로 현재완료 수동태 has been used를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
body: The old coin _______________ by a farmer.
문항.explanation: 설립은 found - founded - founded, 발견은 find - found - found이다.

문항.prompt: 다음 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것을 고르세요.
choices: I was looked down by them.
I was looked down on by them.
I was been looked down by them.
문항.explanation: look down on처럼 여러 낱말이 한 덩어리인 동사는 수동태에서도 전치사를 빠뜨리지 않는다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르시오.
body: Korean dramas can _____ in almost every

문항.prompt: 다음 우리말과 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
문항.explanation: 지각동사의 목적격보어로 쓰인 동사원형은 수동태에서 to부정사로 바뀐다.

문항.prompt: 다음 두 문장의 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.
문항.explanation: 조동사가 있는 수동태는 「조동사 + be + 과거분사」로 쓴다.

choices: He was made wash the car.
I was made happy by the gift.
She will be helped by her friends.
You were asked to wait outside.
문항.explanation: 사역동사 make의 수동태에서는 목적격보어가 to부정사로 바뀌므로 was made to wash로 써야 한다.

문항.prompt: 다음 밑줄 친 부분을 주어로 문장을 바꾸어 쓸때 알맞은 것은?
body: You will send [[your friends]] invitation cards.
choices: Your friends will send invitation cards.
Your friends will sent invitation cards.
Your friends would sent invitation cards.
Your friends will be sent invitation cards.

문항.prompt: 다음 우리말과 의미가 같도록 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 고르시오.

choices: I was surprised at the result.
This song was changed my mood.
I was made a scarf by my aunt.
Thieves will be robbed the bank.
문항.explanation: be surprised at은 감정을 나타내는 수동태 표현이다. 나머지는 목적어가 남아 있어 수동태로 쓸 수 없다.

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르시오.

I will finish the report in two hours.

body: 우리 누나는 아빠가 시켜서 마당을 쓸어야만 했다.

made my dad to sweep the yard
was made sweep the yard by my dad

문항.prompt: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르시오.
body: This wooden toy was made _____ her by Owen.
문항.explanation: make는 3형식으로 바꿀 때 전치사 for를 쓰므로 수동태에서도 for를 쓴다.

문항.prompt: 다음 문장을 수동태의 문장으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
body: I heard her singing in the hall.
choices: She heard me singing in the hall.
She was heard to singing in the hall.
She was heard singing in the hall by me.
I was heard singing in the hall by her.
I was heard to sing in the hall by her.
